summary: Re-review clears the earlier P1s but finds five remaining gaps in release migration digest enforcement, Helm-shaped migration execution, complete route-source coverage, manifest helper enforcement, and real signal interruption tests.
validation: Exact-head QA passed local, immutable, and cleanup checks but hosted evidence is still pending
blockers: Release mode can omit MIGRATION_IMAGE_DIGEST and still use a mutable migration image.
Smoke runs the migration image as the database server instead of the Helm client-against-pinned-Postgres shape.
OpenAPI parity scans only internal/server/http.go, allowing registrations in other Go files to escape.
Public check_migration_assets(root, chart) can bypass the authoritative manifest.
Interrupted-create tests do not send real SIGTERM during in-flight Docker creation.
next_action: Return to code for the five focused fixes, then repeat independent review and exact-head QA before opening the PR.

issues.title: Require migration digest in release mode
issues.details: Release architecture mode must require both app and migration immutable digests before Docker operations.

issues.title: Run Helm-shaped migration client against separate DB
issues.details: Use pinned PostgreSQL server plus resolved migration image as shell/psql client, matching the Helm job contract.

issues.title: Scan all runtime route registration sources
issues.details: Route registrations in other Go files must be detected and compared with the spec/manifest.

issues.title: Enforce manifest through public migration helper
issues.details: Alternate callers/tests must not bypass authoritative migration filename/checksum validation.

issues.title: Test real SIGTERM during each Docker create
issues.details: Subprocess fixtures must signal in-flight network/Postgres/app creates and verify label recovery/cleanup.
